question_text: A 16-year-old girl is brought to the physician because she has not yet had her 1st period. She was born at 39 weeks gestation via spontaneous vaginal delivery. She is up to date on all vaccines and meeting all developmental milestones. She has no history of a serious illness and takes no medications. Physical examination shows underdeveloped breasts with scant pubic and axillary hair. Speculum examination shows a short vagina and no cervix. The remainder of the physical examination shows no abnormalities. Pelvic ultrasound shows no uterus. Which of the following is the most likely karyotype in this patient?
